audience.text: Java developers building applications that require reading, writing, and manipulating Excel .xlsx workbooks without runtime dependencies on Apache POI.

capabilities.text: Create, load, modify, and save Excel .xlsx workbooks through Workbook, WorksheetCollection, Worksheet, and Cells APIs.
capabilities.title: Read and write Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Apply full cell formatting including font, borders, fill, alignment, number format, and protection via Style and Cell APIs.
capabilities.title: Cell formatting and styling

capabilities.text: Configure data validation and conditional formatting on worksheet ranges using ValidationCollection and ConditionalFormattingCollection scoped to CellArea.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Create 18 of 25 chart types programmatically via ChartCollection.add() and add drawing shapes via ShapeCollection with 38 preset geometries.
capabilities.title: Chart and shape rendering

capabilities.text: Create and manage Excel tables (ListObjects) via ListObjectCollection and configure print layout and page setup via PageSetup.
capabilities.title: Table and page setup support

capabilities.text: Add and manage cell comments via CommentCollection and embed images from bytes, streams, or file paths via PictureCollection.
capabilities.title: Comment and image embedding

limitations.text: Saving is currently limited to .xlsx format only.
ChartEx types (Waterfall, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box and Whisker, Funnel, and Map) cannot be created programmatically.
Formulas are stored and round-tripped but the library is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and manipulation in Java without requiring Apache POI at runtime, using a self-contained library.
Supports full round-trip handling of Excel features including cell values, formulas, styling, data validation, conditional formatting, charts, shapes, and tables.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java spreadsheet library for creating, loading, modifying, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks targeting Java 17.

uncertainties: The exact set of unimplemented XML-mapper classes and their impact on metadata preservation is not fully specified.
Whether the 7 ChartEx types preserved verbatim from loaded workbooks retain full fidelity across save/load cycles is unclear.
The behavior of strict-mode toggles in LoadOptions when applied to malformed workbooks is not detailed.
The scope of APIs that exist only to preserve OOXML metadata without providing Excel feature parity is not fully documented.
The runtime behavior of WorkbookProtection and WorksheetProtection when multiple passwords are set is not specified.
The handling of complex shapes loaded from XLSX files beyond preservation is not detailed.
The exact set of supported image formats beyond JPEG, PNG, GIF, and BMP is not confirmed.
The behavior of CalculationProperties settings during formula round-tripping is not specified.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Create a new workbook using Workbook, add values to cells, apply styles, and save as .xlsx using Workbook.save().

workflows.name: Load and inspect workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing .xlsx file using Workbook with LoadOptions and inspect diagnostics via Workbook.getLoadDiagnostics().

workflows.name: Apply formatting and validation
workflows.text: Apply cell styling via Cell.getStyle()/setStyle(), configure data validation via ValidationCollection, and set conditional formatting via ConditionalFormattingCollection.
